Recipe Buttermilk Pancakes

Sour milk gives these their tang, so don't re

A}

Churned buttermilk is ideal here.

INGREDIENTS
2 medium eggs
1 cup buttermilk
pinch of salt
} 1 cup self-raising flour or plain
| flour with baking powder
4 tbs butter
maple syrup, honey,
| stewed apple or fresh berries, to
serve (optional)

ach for plain milk, thinned yogurt works
a treat if you run short, though

METHOD
1 In asmall bowl, whisk the €ggs with the buttermilk and salt.
2. Sift in the flour and fold together, leaving a few lumps
behind.

3. Melt 1 tbs of the butter in a wide frying pan over a medium
heat.

4. When the butter stops foaming, ladle in a little batter.
5. Cook until bubbles break on top, then flip until both sides are
speckled.

6. Lift the pancake onto a warm plate and cover it
loosely while you cook the rest of the batter the same way,
adding 1 tbs butter to the pan each time.
7. Stack the pancakes on warm plates and serve straight away,
with any of the toppings you like.

SERVES 2
